pas.des: Nick Swisher hits a sacrifice bunt. Missed catch error by second baseman Howie Kendrick, assist to first baseman Kendrys Morales. Robinson Cano to 2nd. Nick Swisher to 1st.
Melky Cabrera hits a sacrifice bunt. Throwing error by pitcher Scott Kazmir. Robinson Cano scores. Brett Gardner to 3rd. Melky Cabrera to 2nd.
Derek Jeter grounds out, pitcher Scott Kazmir to first baseman Kendrys Morales.
Mark Teixeira out on a sacrifice fly to center fielder Torii Hunter. Brett Gardner scores. Melky Cabrera to 3rd.
Alex Rodriguez walks. Johnny Damon to 2nd.
Jorge Posada called out on strikes.
